title: Manager prep: Q1 2026 - self notes & goals
content:
Notes to self for 1:1 with manager (Kiera):

Top-level goals (Q1 2026)
- Reduce average time-to-fill for IC roles from 47 -> 35 days (target: -25%). Focus: SWE backend, infra, and applied-ml pipelines.
- Increase offer acceptance rate from 82% -> 88% by tighter hiring communication and faster decisioning.
- Launch 90-day onboarding checklist automation for new hires in infra and serving-runtime teams (goal: 95% completion within 30 days).
- Complete HRIS data migration pilot (Phase 1) and triage integration blockers with platform eng by end of Feb.
- Pilot manager calibration process for mid-year comp discussions; produce a clear rubric for promotion readiness for IC3->IC4.

Accomplishments since last review
- Rolled out updated interview scorecard templates for applied-ml and serving-runtime; hiring managers report clearer signal on technical depth and production readiness.
- Negotiated with recruiting ops to prioritize candidate comms; implemented templated offer timelines (expectation setting reduced negotiation cycles by ~1 day).
- Ran 3 hiring manager workshops (Dec-Feb) on inclusive interviewing; attendance 82% across hiring managers.
- Coordinated with infra to spin up a short-term recruitment cloud budget for campus internship recruiting (pilot accepted 12 interns).

Metrics / talking points
- Time-to-fill: 47 days -> 41 days YTD; progress: +13% improvement but still short of 35-day goal.
- Offer acceptance: 84% YTD (seasonal dip after December) - hypothesis: counteroffers + late-stage process length.
- Onboarding completion: current 78% for infra/new grad hires; manual reminders are the choke point.
- Internship conversion to return offer: 67% (need to improve pre-intern experience and manager touchpoints).

Blockers / risks to escalate
- HRIS migration: API rate limits from vendor causing nightly sync failures; platform-eng attention needed.
- Recruiting headcount: hiring for two additional full-cycle recruiters delayed by Legal signoff for vendor contract. Impact: capacity for timely outreach.
- Compensation calibration: no centralized comp band for some specialized infra roles; need leadership approval for market adjustments.

Manager asks / agenda items for 1:1
1) Permission to reallocate one recruiter FTE to dedicated infra hiring for 3 months to hit Q2 commitments.
2) Budget ask: $12k for vendor support on HRIS migration (to cover consultant hours to unblock rate-limit workaround).
3) Guidance/approval on promotion rubric draft (attached in Confluence link); ask for 1-2 reviewers to validate IC3->IC4 criteria.
4) Quick sync on compensation reserve for spot market adjustments (esp. inference infra hires).
5) Flag: need help prioritizing a patch to the onboarding automation vs. recruitment sourcing tools - which should drive team effort next sprint?

Draft talking lines for manager 1:1
- "Progress on time-to-fill is positive; we have concrete levers (sourcing cadence, faster decision gates) but we need short-term recruiter capacity to reach stretch targets."
- "HRIS is the gating item for cleaner headcount reporting and offer acceptance insights; investing in the migration now reduces people ops toil later."
- "Promotion rubric will reduce manager bias and make calibration faster - ask is for your review and to sponsor it during exec calibration."

Promotion readiness notes (people I think are close)
- Priya Nair (IC3 applied-ml): Leading infra-facing evals, owns quantization hiring funnel, high peer feedback. Recommendation: accelerate review to May.
- Leo Martin (IC3 infra): Strong on deployment and SLOs, needs more cross-team project visibility; can be promoted if he leads one cross-functional rollout by Q2.

Action items (my immediate todo list)
- [ ] Draft the recruiter reallocation proposal and ROI model (due: 2026-03-05).
- [ ] Create a HRIS issues doc with observed failures + repro steps and assign to platform-eng SLO (due: 2026-03-04).
- [ ] Share promotion rubric with Kiera and TL reviewers (due: 2026-03-07).
- [ ] Schedule follow-up meeting with Legal on vendor contract blockers (due: 2026-03-09).
- [ ] Prepare a 2-slide summary for exec sync: hiring KPIs + specific asks (due: 2026-03-10).

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep the ask small and specific in manager 1:1 - recruiter reallocation + $12k vendor support. Provide ROI (reduced time-to-fill impact on product velocity).
- Use recent hiring manager workshop feedback as evidence for scorecard improvements.
- If compensation reserve is blocked, propose a temporary signing bonus for key infra roles (lower approval friction).

Links / references
- Promotion rubric draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HR/Promotion+Rubric+Draft
- HRIS migration ticket: JIRA-OPS-987
- Hiring KPIs dashboard: https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/hiring-kpis

Quick scratchpad for answers managers might ask:
- Q: "How will recruiter reallocation affect other queues?"
  A: We shift one recruiter from generalist queue where pipeline is >2x vs reqs; we'll re-balance sourcing tasks and measure SLA by weekly check-ins.
- Q: "What's the expected lift from consultant spend?"
  A: Estimate 2-3 weeks of consultant work to implement robust backoff and pagination for HRIS syncs; reduces nightly failures by ~90% and avoids manual reconciliation (saves ~40 hours/mo).

Random thoughts (notes to archive later)
- Build a short-case study for the internship program to improve conversion; capture manager touchpoints and project quality metrics.
- Consider an onboarding buddy program for infra hires tied to the first 30-day milestone (quick win).

End of notes.

(Keep this doc as my working manager prep - will clean and move into Confluence before exec sync.)
